gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-jp: Glowing and vibrant, Neon draws every letter with one uninterrupted line width, while Noto Sans JP stands tall with curves that sweep open. Over a long passage, the sans keeps a modern, tidy pace.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Vibrant steel-rod letters light up the top. Noto Sans Kaithi settles below as a plain sans, its lowercase filling each line like capitals, so a long passage reads in a contemporary, level way.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Neon cuts its letters like stencils, one steady width from start to finish, with generous spacing between every glyph pair. Noto Sans Kannada does the reading work, bumping gently from small letters to capitals.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Glowing and compass-drawn, Neon keeps its lines uniform and its letters spaced open. Noto Sans Kayah Li follows as a plain sans with lifted brush ends, so a long passage reads clean and unfussy.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Vibrant tubes of neon glass spell out the heading, each letter with the same open spacing, against a body whose curves never close back on themselves. Long stretches of Noto Sans Kharoshthi read approachable and dark.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Glass-tube glow, tall and stamped. Noto Sans Khmer sits beside it as sans-serif with chisel-notch openings and proud small letters, letting Neon's single-thread line feel even more like a bright sign.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Neon's n arches come out as thick as the stems beside them, a stamped-metal look that glows. And Noto Sans Khojki answers as a plain sans with large-eyed e shapes, wide exits letting light through.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Noto Sans Khudawadi leads with low contrast and unsealed rounds. Neon traces each stroke at one stylus width for a glowing, vibrant sign, while the sans stays clean and approachable once the text runs on.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-kr: Neon never flickers between thick and thin, every stroke glowing at a single width over tall stamped-metal lowercase forms. Its strongest quality is how it lets Noto Sans KR stay generous and clean.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-lao: Strokes with no thick-thin shift, and joins as heavy as the strokes. Neon is best at glowing, vibrant display lettering, while Noto Sans Lao, a plain sans with a lifted x-height and open mouths, is best at carrying the reading.
